formal_scope: Full finite-table P32 for real finite-dimensional inner-product maps, hence rectangular real matrices with their Euclidean norms. Actual sorted, zero-padded singular values satisfy the all-index operator perturbation bound. The leading-r left subspace is constructed as images of ordered right Gram modes and proved to be the span of orthonormal left Gram modes; its dimension and exact residual norm are derived. Positive true rank and noise ≤ε<σ_r(X)/2 imply rank separation and projection gap ≤2ε/σ_r(X)<1 without supplied inverse, tail or projection-gap premises. For arbitrary orthonormal bases of the true and learned ranges, the actual cross-matrix minimum singular value is ≥sqrt(1−(2ε/σ_r(X))²), estimated coordinates are injective, and the explicit ordinary matrix inverse decoder U(UhatᵀU)⁻¹ has both inverse laws and the stated norm bound. The maximum possible rank convention is proved using zero padding. This does not certify that a finite table captures the full process.
